"Sona Kitna Sona Hai" is a foot-tapping number from "Crew," starring Tabu, Kareena Kapoor Khan, and Kriti Sanon. Sung by IP Singh and Nupoor Khedkar, with music recreated by Akshay and IP Singh, and lyrics penned by IP Singh, this song is known for its lively beats and energetic vibe.

Movie Name - Crew
